description: Load humanizer on text, documentation, and written content.
Load humanizer when code or design changes contain prose.
Load impeccable on visual style files.
Load impeccable on components whose changes touch styling.
Load impeccable on any design request targeting a UI element.
Load Supabase skills on any Supabase task.
Load playwright-agent on any task using Playwright or navigating to a local server.
When creating a design, invoke /impeccable shape before writing any code.
When fixing or repairing a design, invoke impeccable audit before the fix and /impeccable critique after.
When improving or polishing a design, invoke /impeccable polish.
After any significant design task, invoke /impeccable critique to verify the result. Add impeccable audit when the change is complex.
When an AI writing pattern is detected, fix it immediately before continuing. Patterns: not-X-but-Y contrasts, forced triads, excessive dashes, empty phrases, marketing jargon, superlatives.
